summary: All four ACs are present, faithful and in-scope. AC1 (spec L20-24): ModalShell.tsx:76 Dialog.Content now carries `flex max-h-[80dvh] flex-col` with position preserved (`top-[10%]`, per Internal Plan Review finding #2 at spec L134), header (L80) and footer (L187) `shrink-0`, `<form>` (L115) `flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col`, scroll-body wrapper (L139) `min-h-0 flex-1` and ModalScrollBody `max-h-full gap-4` — the `calc(100vh-280px)` magic budget is gone and the dialog cannot exceed 90% of viewport height (10% top + 80dvh), so the footer is structurally on-screen; DO-NOT #24 respected (className restricted to `max-h-*`/`gap-*`, invariant left in ModalScrollBody). AC2 (L25-28): TriageDetailModal.tsx:269 action row is now `flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2.5 mt-4 items-center` — exactly the mini-plan step-2 change, nothing else in that file. AC3 (L29-32): PerProjectTriageSection.tsx section `mb-8 max-md:mb-4` (L125), h2 `mb-3 max-md:mb-2` (L138), open-items `mb-4 max-md:mb-2` (L173); DeferredTriageSection.tsx:43 `mb-4 max-md:mb-2` — desktop values untouched. AC4 (L33-36): TriageFilterSortBar.tsx gates a `Filters & sort` toggle (chevron + `aria-expanded`, matching the Design Notes at L74-77) on `useIsPhoneViewport()` (`max-width: 767px`, exactly the `max-md:` breakpoint) with `phoneOpen` defaulting to false and content rendered when `!isPhone || phoneOpen`; at >=768px `isPhone` is false so no toggle renders and content is always visible — 'exactly as before' holds. Out of Scope (L46-63) honoured: EditTaskModal/ContinuePipelineModal/CampaignLaunchDialog still carry the raw-vh pattern (verified: `max-h-[calc(100vh-260px)]`, `max-h-[calc(100vh-280px)]`, `max-h-[80vh]`), `.page-container` untouched, no triage-card metadata removed; the 40px triage action buttons are correctly left alone per the disclosed limitation at L139. Touched-file set matches the mini-plan's table exactly (11 files, confirmed by an iterate-marker sweep over client/). Three non-blocking observations for Stage 2, none an AC divergence: (1) TriageFilterSortBar.tsx:77 also adds `max-md:mb-2` to the bar container — a surface AC3 does not enumerate, but phone-only, 8px, and provably desktop-identical so AC4's 'exactly as before' is preserved; (2) AC1's E2E opens the dialog at 1280px then resizes to 375x667 and substitutes 'More options expanded' for the AC's 'filling enough fields' — the taller-body precondition is still met and the fix is CSS-only, so the AC would pass either way; (3) AC3's E2E measures resolved computed `marginBottom` at both viewports rather than the mini-plan's suggested open-items-bottom-to-Deferred-heading distance — still a real-browser measurement (not a class fence), so the plan-review gap it was raised against is closed. Code-reviewer (Stage 2) may proceed.
